You are a fresh, independent reviewer of a filled Stagebench assessment. Work only inside this directory. Do not read the parent repo, other runs, other scores, or try to identify who built the artifact.

Read EVAL.md, then review assessment.json against artifact/, build/, and inputs/. Check every rating and every measurement is fair and grounded in concrete evidence. Flag any rating that is unsupported, overstated, or too harsh.

If you find problems, write a corrected assessment.json (keep a copy of the original as assessment.original.json first) so the file remains valid and complete, with evaluatorModel exactly claude-opus-5. If the assessment is fair, leave assessment.json unchanged and write a short REVIEW.md saying so, listing any residual notes that do not change ratings.

When done, write DONE-REVIEW and a brief verdict.
